title: Why Cheaper iPad Minis May Get a Weaker A20 Pro
description: Apple announced an OLED iPad mini with the A20 Pro on 26 October 2026 at 699 dollars, with preorders from 28 October and sales from 6 November. Notebookcheck reports the 128 and 256 gigabyte models use a five-core CPU version while the 512 gigabyte model has six cores; TechCrunch lists six cores generally, so check Apple's spec page.

beats.vo: Same chip name, but is it the same chip?

beats.text: Chip binning: sorting chips by quality
points: Weaker ones sold as cheaper tiers
beats.vo: Chip makers test every chip and sort them. Notebookcheck reports the cheaper iPad mini storage tiers get an A twenty Pro with five C P U cores, while the biggest gets six. TechCrunch lists six cores, so check Apple's spec page.
Follow for a daily dose of engineering.

caption:
Same chip name ≠ same chip. 🔍
The new OLED iPad mini ($699, preorders 28 Oct) uses the A20 Pro — Notebookcheck says the 128/256 GB tiers have a 5-core CPU, the 512 GB has 6. TechCrunch lists 6 cores, so check Apple's spec page before you buy.
That's chip binning: factories sort chips by quality.
